summary: Spark I Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K/A amending Item 8.01 of its September 29, 2026 report to correct the estimated redemption price for its Class A ordinary shares ahead of the extraordinary general meeting to approve the proposed business combination with ZincFive, Inc. The company will make a one-time Additional Contribution of $0.10 per unredeemed public share into the trust account on October 5, 2026, raising the per-share amount payable on redemption or liquidation. Withdrawal deadline for prior redemption requests is October 3, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. ET; original price approximately $11.60. Watch redemption levels and closing certainty.
